claim_text: The FBI is investigating an apparent intrusion into its National Crime Information Center (NCIC)
summary: CNN, NBC News, AP, ABC News, MS NOW and Fox News each report, citing their own unnamed sources, that the FBI is investigating an apparent breach or hack of NCIC.
detail: NBC News (two people briefed), AP (one person familiar with the matter), ABC News (one law enforcement source, who it says confirmed the database was hacked), MS NOW (two people familiar with the matter, who say hackers accessed NCIC) and Fox News (three sources familiar with the matter, who say hackers breached NCIC) each have their own sourcing, separate from CNN's two. Reuters, WUSA9, BleepingComputer and others relay CNN and count with it. None of these sources is named, and the FBI has not confirmed it.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: CNN and NBC News each cite two people briefed; AP one person familiar; ABC News a law enforcement source; MS NOW two people familiar; Fox News three sources. Reuters, WUSA9 and BleepingComputer relay CNN and count with it.
notes: Relabelled from Reported on Nov 21, 2026: NBC News is a second outlet with its own sources. AP and ABC News added Nov 21 evening; MS NOW and Fox News added Nov 21 at about 9:05 PM ET. This confirms that an investigation into an apparent breach is under way, not what was reached or who did it.

claim_text: The intrusion was found in recent days, and FBI officials knew of it by Thursday, Nov 19
summary: CNN says the intrusion was discovered 'in recent days' and that bureau officials had learned of it by Thursday, Nov 19.
detail: CNN does not give a discovery date or say when the intrusion began. WUSA9's summary of CNN says officials learned of it on Thursday.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: CNN says 'the discovery of the latest intrusion in recent days' and refers to Thursday, after bureau officials learned of it.

claim_text: The FBI has not commented publicly on the report
summary: The FBI did not respond to CNN, Reuters, BleepingComputer, ABC News, MS NOW or Fox News, gave NBC News no comment and declined to comment to AP. By the morning of Nov 23, no FBI statement on NCIC had been found.
detail: Rechecked about 8:19 AM ET on Nov 23 by web search. The President (Nov 21) and the Director of National Intelligence (Nov 22) spoke about the reports (see the claims below), but neither is an FBI statement. An FBI statement would change most of this page.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: CNN, Reuters, BleepingComputer, ABC News, MS NOW and Fox News each say the FBI did not respond to them, NBC News says the FBI had no comment, and AP says the FBI declined; the FBI press page lists no NCIC statement.

claim_text: What was accessed, how the intruders got in, and who they are
summary: No source says what part of NCIC was reached, how the intruders got in, or who is responsible. No one has claimed it.
detail: CNN calls them 'apparent hackers'. MS NOW's sources say hackers accessed NCIC, and Fox News says the FBI is investigating how the intruders got in; neither says what was reached or how. ABC News says the perpetrators and scale are unclear. A retired FBI agent quoted by Fox News listed possible ways in (a stolen password, a state terminal or a vendor) as general possibilities, not findings. Naming an attacker needs official or independent sourcing.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: CNN, Reuters and NBC News report only that an investigation exists; ABC News says who did it and the scale are unclear; MS NOW and Fox News report access but not what or how.

claim_text: Whether any NCIC records were copied or changed
summary: No source says records were copied or changed. MS NOW says it is unclear how much data was extracted. A former FBI official told CNN the bigger worry is whether the accuracy of records could be compromised.
detail: A retired FBI agent told Fox News there is no indication yet that any records were altered. He and the former official in CNN were speaking about the risk, not reporting an FBI finding.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: CNN quotes the former official's concern about record accuracy; MS NOW says it is unclear how much data was extracted; Fox News quotes the retired agent. None reports a finding on data taken or altered.

claim_text: NCIC is the FBI-run database that criminal justice agencies nationwide use to share records
summary: The FBI says NCIC holds records entered by criminal justice agencies nationwide; as of 2023 it had 22 files, more than 18 million active records and over 100,000 partners.
detail: These are the FBI's own figures, not counts of anything affected.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The FBI's NCIC page gives the 22 files, 18 million-plus active records and 100,000-plus criminal justice partners.

claim_text: Police use NCIC in everyday checks such as traffic stops, and must confirm a hit before acting
summary: The FBI says officers use NCIC to learn instantly whether a driver is wanted or a vehicle stolen, and that a hit must be confirmed before official action.
detail: This is why a former FBI official told CNN record accuracy matters.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The FBI's NCIC page describes traffic-stop use and says agencies must confirm a hit before acting on it.

claim_text: In September, the FBI jobs site was breached; the FBI blamed a contractor's missed security patch
summary: ShinyHunters claimed a breach of FBIJobs.gov in September. In October an FBI cyber official said a contractor failed to apply a security patch, and the FBI removed the contractor.
detail: This is a separate, earlier incident. It is on this page for context because CNN calls the NCIC intrusion the second FBI breach in recent months.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: NBC quotes the FBI's statement on the contractor's missed patch; BleepingComputer and TechCrunch separately report the breach.

claim_text: The NCIC intrusion is the second breach of an FBI system in recent months
summary: CNN and Reuters describe the NCIC intrusion as the second breach of an FBI system in recent months, after the September jobs-site breach.
detail: Reuters' framing comes from CNN's report, so it counts once.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: CNN calls it 'the second such breach in recent months' and names the September jobs-site attack.

claim_text: The NCIC intrusion is linked to this week's FAA, NSA, Microsoft 365 or Apple outages
summary: No source links them. CNN mentions the week's outages only as background and does not say they are connected.
detail: Officials have said the week's outages were not a cyberattack, but that was said before the NCIC report and does not mention NCIC.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: CNN and Reuters mention the outages as context only; neither reports a connection.

claim_text: On Nov 18, the White House said the week's tech outages were not a cyberattack
summary: A White House release quotes the DNI: 'This is not a cyberattack,' and Secretary Rubio saying there is 'zero evidence' the incidents involved hackers or any malign actor.
detail: The release came out on Nov 18, before officials reportedly learned of the NCIC intrusion, and it does not mention NCIC or the FBI.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The White House release quotes both officials on the recent outages; it is dated Nov 18 and does not mention NCIC.

claim_text: The NCIC intrusion is linked to the September jobs-site breach or to ShinyHunters
summary: No source says the two FBI incidents are connected or that the same group is behind both.
detail: CNN reports them side by side only as a pattern of FBI breaches.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: CNN and NBC News describe the September breach as prior context and do not connect it; BleepingComputer says there is no indication the NCIC incident is connected to ShinyHunters or the earlier breach.

claim_text: the President spoke about the reported NCIC hack on Nov 21 but gave no details
summary: In a Fox News phone interview on Saturday, Nov 21, the President said of the reports: 'Well, we just heard about it, and I will say that it's not good. I don't like that.'
detail: He did not say what was reached, how, or by whom, and did not confirm the details of the reports. He suggested, without evidence, that the hack might surface information about past investigations; ABC News notes NCIC would not hold information on those investigations. The White House had not commented separately.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: ABC News, The Hill and Axios each quote the same remark from the Fox News interview. The Hill says he did not confirm the reports.
notes: Confirms that the President commented, not that NCIC was hacked. Read as a reaction to the reports, not an official confirmation.

claim_text: NCIC service for police has been interrupted
summary: No source reports an NCIC outage. A retired FBI agent told Fox News there is no indication yet that the system is having an outage.
detail: He is not speaking for the FBI, and no FBI statement or police agency has addressed service. BleepingComputer says it is unclear whether availability was affected.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Fox News quotes the retired agent saying there is no indication yet of an outage; BleepingComputer says it is unclear whether the intrusion affected availability to law enforcement.

claim_text: The Director of National Intelligence said on Nov 22 that the FBI 'has an incident' and is handling it, but gave no details
summary: On ABC's This Week on Nov 22, asked about the reported FBI database hack, the DNI said: 'they have an incident. They're dealing with it in the ordinary course.' He declined to say who was behind it.
detail: He said the FBI would get answers 'in due course' and share the facts with the public. He did not say what was reached, how, by whom, or whether anything was compromised, and he did not use the word hack himself. He also discussed the FBI incident on Fox News Sunday the same day. This is an on-record official acknowledging an FBI incident, not an FBI statement confirming an NCIC breach.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: ABC News published the transcript of the interview; the quoted words are the DNI's own, on the record. Fox News' video page says he discussed the NCIC hack on Fox News Sunday.
notes: Confirms what the DNI said, not what happened inside NCIC.
